  a jsdoc or schema line describes, the validator a skill teaches — reviewed for agreement with the contract.
  Widen it freely, ⛔ never below `hits`; the record's `Scope:` line names the implementing files apart from `hits`.
  The rest of the diff (tests, unrelated modules, lockfiles, generated output, changesets) is the lane seat's
  ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`, exactly as a standalone PR of those files.
  ④ judges the `hits` files and those implementing files ONLY:
  lockfiles, generated output, changesets and prose elsewhere in the PR are not reviewed;
  code outside the diff is READ to judge them, never reviewed.

Rule change — a `hits` path sits under `.claude/**`: the PR body declares `Rule-change:` and you verify it against the diff.
  Write `Rule-change-verified: none` ONLY when no changed hunk alters what an agent may do without the maintainer
  (merge, bypass a check, change repository settings), what gets done and in what order (grading, dispatch, scope), or
  what must go to him (decisions, maintainer actions); process steps, scripts, wording, slimming and file moves are not rule
  changes. Write `ruled` ONLY when every such hunk copies the ruling the PR body quotes on its `Ruling-ref:` line — check the
  copy against the quoted words, do not re-rule it. Otherwise `yes`: the pull request then waits for the maintainer.

⛔ READ-ONLY. No worktree, no checkout, no build, no test run, no gate re-run, no ablation: the check-runs
   on the head already answered every derived gate family, and a local run costs more than it returns.
   If ONE probe is unavoidable, the record's `Local-runs:` line says `probe — REASON`; otherwise `none`.
   Scratch space is `/tmp/claude-0/-home-user/3d3cbaf6-4903-5fed-92d4-c2b94a45e868/scratchpad/pr-36205/` alone; nothing there you did not write this round is read.

Judge, in the record's own sections:
  ① Derived judgments — every accept-set and public-surface change the diff implies, each named right or wrong.
  ② Semver level — the changeset (or `skip-changeset`) matches what the diff publishes, and the `Clause-②:` line.
  ③ Boundary flags — every dev flag and every `open_questions` entry answered, or escalated.
     On every face, SQL push-down: a new id materialisation or in-app join where SQL could push down is a
     finding unless a reason is given (AGENTS.md, Prime Directive 5: SQL first).
  ④ Design judgment — for EVERY `hits` file: does the change hold against the code it cites and the
     scenario it is accepted against? A skill file against the card's eval prompt and the spec it teaches
     on `main`; a schema file against the ruling or ADR it implements and its first consumer; an ADR
     against its first consumer and its execution plan. For EVERY implementing file in the diff: does the
     code agree with the contract, sentence by sentence? Read the cited code in the live tree, and try to
     break the design.
     Grade each finding must-fix, should-fix or nit — a nit has no effect on correctness or the contract.
     A must-fix is a FAIL; a must-fix or should-fix earns a delta review of its fix; nits alone end the round.
     Spell a must-fix or should-fix with its id and grade, `S1 (should-fix) — …`, and a clean round as
     `No must-fix, no should-fix.`: the queue guard reads a graded finding as OPEN on this head and
     refuses the record; the delta record names those it closes by id alone, `S1: closed`.
     A nit is fixed only on the prose faces, or left as an accepted deviation or a follow-up card: a fix
     anywhere else moves the head, and this record no longer covers it.

### The five rule changes against the ruling (7075909669, card #36203 To do 1-5 "as proposed")
1. **`filing-gate.md`:** 「次序偏好列在专题卡」 → 「先后只写后卡 `Blocked-by:`」. Matches item 1, and removes the contradiction with `seat-lifecycle.md` 56. ✔
2. **`execution-duties.md` 49 (new):** 「定「等 #N」即同笔写卡 `Blocked-by: #N`+`pm:blocked`;⛔ 只记记忆或评论,无读者即漏派」. Matches item 2; "the target merging releases it through the existing scan" is already the unlock scan's job (`seat-lifecycle.md` 待命五项), so not restating it is right. ✔
3. **`seat-lifecycle.md` 90:** 「每轮对所接车道与专题跑 `card-pick.mjs --order <序> --why`,报空即贴;无卡点即当轮派,⛔ 不得报空」. Matches item 3's first half. **The second arm of item 3, "or its reason is written on the card", is not in the text** (see S1). ⚠
4. **`dispatch-runbook.md` card-thread section, two new lines:** the thread checks Actions started and not `dirty` 10 min after each push, else merges `main` and pushes again; every CI wait leaves a `send_later` ≤ 30 min; the seat reads `pr-state.mjs` for every in-flight card PR each round and wakes the thread on zero Actions 30 min after a push, `dirty`, or 2 h with no push and no report. Every trigger and number of item 4 is there. ✔
5. **`execution-duties.md` 177:** the status probe now covers 「dev 与卡线程」. Matches item 5. ✔

### Ceilings: each raise equals the ruled delta, no extra headroom
Measured with `wc -c` on `origin/main` (`b3bcfefc` side of the merge) and the head:

| file | main bytes / old ceiling | head bytes / new ceiling | ceiling delta | ruling |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| dispatch-runbook | 20068 / 20070 | 20354 / 20354 | +284 | 20070 → 20354 (+284) ✔ |
| execution-duties | 20154 / 20154 | 20277 / 20277 | +123 | 20148 → 20271 (+123), rebased on main's +6 (ruling 7073679594) ✔ |
| filing-gate | 9096 / 9096 | 9101 / 9101 | +5 | 9096 → 9101 ✔ |
| seat-lifecycle | 9070 / 9070 | 9076 / 9076 | +6 | 9070 → 9076 ✔ |

All four end at headroom 0. Each row's comment cites 7075909669 and quotes 「同意五条都改」; the existing provenance of the execution-duties and filing-gate rows is kept.

### The main-merge resolution (your third check)
`git show --remerge-diff 7971a712`: the only hand edit in a skill file is `dispatch-runbook.md` 137, 「≤30 分钟」 → 「≤30分钟」 (one space). Why: the PR's text is +287 bytes over its old base `fa304140` (20067 → 20354, the ruling's +284 plus the 3 bytes of headroom the file had then); `main` meanwhile grew the file +1 (#36213, `e4f5e56c`), so a clean merge would read 20355, one over the ruled ceiling. Trimming that byte keeps the ruled number. The conflict git reported was in `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` (main's own execution-duties +6 row); its resolution keeps both raises in one row. ✔

### Findings (no hold)
- **S1 (for the seat and the Fable L2).** Item 3 as ruled reads "A child with no hold reason is dispatched that round, **or its reason is written on the card**." The line keeps only 「无卡点即当轮派」. Read against the rest of the skill, the dropped arm is mostly subsumed: item 2 now makes every wait a `Blocked-by:` + `pm:blocked` on the card, and `pm:blocked` / `pm:on-hold` / open `Blocked-by:` are already 卡点 (the next line's vocabulary is "the candidate definition's inverse"). What it would still cover is a hold that is none of those. Either restore it (≈ +15 bytes, paid by deletion in the same file, since the ruled ceiling is +6), or say in the body that items 2 + the 卡点 vocabulary carry it. I do not hold the PR for it; the Fable L2 is the review of record on rule text.
- **N1.** The body says the rows move "by exactly the measured `wc -c` deltas". For dispatch-runbook the file grew +286 over current `main` and the ceiling +284 (2 bytes were existing headroom); "exactly the ruled deltas, ending at headroom 0" is the accurate sentence.
- **N2.** 「≤30分钟」 now sits beside 「10 分钟」 / 「30 分钟」 with a space in the same two lines. Cosmetic.

L1 never replaces L2. Tier H: os-zhuang.
